name: Multiple Regression with Multivariate Adaptive Shrinkage (mr.mash)
model_likelihood: Y = XB + E; E matrix-normal with row covariance I_n and outcome covariance V
prior: Mixture of zero-centered multivariate normals over each predictor effect vector; fixed covariance collection and fitted mixture weights
inference_algorithm: Variational empirical Bayes; predictor-wise coordinate ascent with BMSR-mix updates; ELBO fitting of w0 and V; variational imputation of missing outcomes
estimand: Approximate posterior mean regression coefficients; predictions Xnew Bhat
data_input: Individual-level predictor matrix X and outcome matrix Y on the same samples; missing Y permitted
tunable_settings: Prior covariance collection S0 (sharing patterns, scales and number K)
